provenance.description: holus evidence --mode auto concatenated all four providers' items in fixed order and sliced the first 20 for display, with no per-provider quota; a single early-scanned provider (e.g. exact_provider's own 30-match budget) could by itself exhaust the display cap and silently push out every item from providers that already reported state=ok.

notes: Candidate = cli_axi._select_display_items (the shipped fix). Status-quo control = the pre-fix concatenate-then-slice merge, reimplemented in eval_pilot.py purely as a frozen comparator, never wired into production.

provenance.description: docs/decisions/0006-two-deployment-modes.md references specs/002-deployment-modes.md, which does not exist (the repository's actual spec 002 is 002-embedding-model-config.md). Deliberately left unfixed pending a human product decision, per spec 013 section 4 item 9.

notes: Protects the exact provider's dangling-reference detection against silent regression. This is a real, currently-unresolved repository fact (not a synthetic fixture) -- if it ever starts resolving, or stops being flagged, that is itself worth a human look.

provenance.description: consistency.check_consistency() immediately after consistency.refresh() on unchanged content must report up_to_date -- the deterministic hash-diffing contract spec 013 section 4 item 8 describes.

notes: Runs against a small synthetic tmp repo built fresh per run, never this worktree's own .holusight/ cache.

provenance.description: axi_providers._no_egress_env() must strip VOYAGE_API_KEY from the process environment for the duration of a provider call unless the caller explicitly opts into egress, per spec 015 section 3 (Egress default), and must restore it afterward.

notes: Security-relevant invariant; a silent regression here would re-open an egress path that spec 015's egress default exists to close.
